about: TEMPLATE — copy this to goldset.json and replace the examples with 8 questions about YOUR my_framework_kb.md: 6 with answerable=true and 2 with answerable=false. The notebook warns you if an evidence phrase is not in your KB word-for-word.

how_to_fill_this_in.question: how a practitioner would really ask it, not a keyword search
how_to_fill_this_in.evidence: one short phrase copied WORD-FOR-WORD from your KB. Under ~80 characters, on one line. Leave empty for the 2 unanswerable questions.

questions.question: EXAMPLE — delete this. What are the four core functions of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework?
evidence: a short phrase copied word-for-word from your KB

questions.question: EXAMPLE — delete this. The OFF-TOPIC question: clearly outside cybersecurity, e.g. What is the capital of France?

EXAMPLE — delete this. The SOUNDS-RIGHT-BUT-ABSENT question: name a DIFFERENT framework your KB never covers, phrased exactly like your other questions — e.g. if your KB is the NIST AI RMF, ask about the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. Shared vocabulary is the point: this is the question that will expose a threshold that is too loose, and an easy off-topic question like Q7 will not.
